shots.visual: 黑暗中林昭猛地睁眼，胸口锁链纹炸亮，金光从衣襟缝里透出，映亮他扭曲的脸和滚落的汗珠。
shots.prompt_en: Lin Zhao, eyes snapping open in darkness, glowing chain tattoo on chest, golden light bursting through robe seams, distorted face, rolling sweat droplets, dark environment, intense golden glow lighting

shots.visual: 深夜杂役柴房全景，月光从破窗漏进来，草席散乱，墙角立着几把锈剑，梁上挂着蛛网。
shots.prompt_en: night, full view of shabby servant woodshed, moonlight leaking through broken window, scattered straw mats, several rusty swords leaning in corner, cobwebs hanging from rafters, dim blue moonlight, dusty interior

shots.visual: 他痛得蜷缩着抓挠木板，指甲刮出木屑，油灯被气劲震灭，只剩月光勾出他绷紧的侧脸。
shots.prompt_en: boy curled up in pain, clawing wooden floor, fingernails scraping wood splinters, oil lamp blown out by qi burst, darkness, moonlight outlining tense side profile, night

shots.visual: 窗纸被雷光映得惨白，一道无声天雷破窗劈入，锁链纹腾空化作虚影，在半空把整条雷光吞下去。
shots.prompt_en: white paper window lit by lightning, silent heavenly thunder breaking through window, chain-pattern runes rising into air as phantom, devouring entire lightning bolt midair, dark interior, harsh lightning glow

shots.visual: 雷光散尽，屋内陈设安然无恙，只有地面焦出一圈人形轮廓，窗外竹林还在冒青烟。
shots.action: 青烟上升、焦痕余烬明灭
shots.prompt_en: aftermath of lightning strike, human-shaped scorch mark on floor, intact room interior, furniture unharmed, smoke rising from bamboo forest outside window, faint embers, dim indoor lighting, eerie calm

shots.visual: 门口站着瞎眼灰袍老人老墨，铁杖点地，枯手攥住林昭手腕，月光照亮他空洞的眼窝。
shots.dialogue: 老墨：想活命，就别解开它。
shots.prompt_en: blind old man, grey robe, standing at doorway, iron staff touching ground, withered hand gripping young man's wrist, empty eye sockets, moonlight illuminating face, night, tense atmosphere
